correctness.rationale: Each threshold is proved by an explicit boundary failure, exhaustive exact treatment of the only remaining high-support finite range, primorial extremality on the adjacent interval, and an analytic tail from Axler and Rosser--Schoenfeld bounds. The finite certificate verifies all support cases and positive comparison margins, while the tail quotient is proved monotone in the required range.

originality.rationale: The motivating preprint determines N_1 through N_6 and M_1 through M_5 and states the general equality M_k=N_{k+1} as a conjecture. Searches for the two exact boundary integers, N_7, N_8, M_6=N_7, M_7=N_8, and equivalent totient-versus-prime-counting threshold formulations found no prior determination of either new pair. Classical explicit inequalities and primorial extremality are not claimed as new. Originality remains to the best of our knowledge because the motivating preprint is recent.

value.rationale: The result extends a newly stated exact-threshold conjecture by two consecutive cases, identifies the exact last failures and their factorizations, and provides a reproducible finite certificate together with an analytic proof of the infinite tails.
